profile.name: Neon Harbor
profile.title: A cyberpunk-cozy harbor town your agents live in
profile.description: An empty harbor you fill with agents you already have. The docks and the workshop are the stage; nothing stands there until you add someone.

handoffs: A fault on the docks -> Night Watch reproduces -> Harbor Engineer patches -> Night Watch verifies -> the lamps go green
A new build -> Harbor Engineer implements -> Night Watch smoke-checks the happy path when asked

memory.content: Neon Harbor is an empty stage. Add agents you already have. They speak in the place you assign; the harbor does not ship a cast.

shared.gettingStarted: Plant the harbor, then add agents you already have from the Worlds page. The pack does not import a cast.
